about.title: About ShyRe Creations
about.subtitle: The alchemy of preserving life's golden memories.

sections.title: Where passion meets archival precision.
paragraphs: ShyRe Creations was born out of an appreciation for memories that are too precious to fade. Founded with an intimate atelier spirit, we set out to elevate resin art from craft into fine heirloom artistry.

Each commission begins with understanding your story: a wedding bouquet carried down the aisle, a child's milestone token, or flowers from a heartfelt goodbye. We treat every petal with profound reverence, utilizing our proprietary dehydration and pigment stabilization formula.
Our studio combines timeless luxury aesthetics with contemporary minimalist craft. When you hold a ShyRe creation, you hold a moment suspended in glass-like clarity forever.
sections.quote: Love is immortal, and your memories deserve to be held in your hands, touched, and admired every single day.

projects.title: Seraphina Bridal Archival Hexagon
projects.description: Archival dehydration and 6-layer optical resin casting of white ranunculus and blush garden roses.
projects.longDescription: Commissioned for an Italian destination wedding, this 10-inch geometric hexagon preserved fragile white ranunculus, eucalyptus leaves, and delicate blush peony petals. Layered with subtle 24k gold leaf veining.

projects.title: Celestial Rose Gold Agate Coasters
projects.description: Set of 6 organic geode resin coasters infused with real baby's breath, rose pigments, and gilded brass edges.
projects.longDescription: A celebration gift set inspired by fluid agate geode structures. Incorporating preserved baby's breath blossoms, natural rose quartz crystals, and hand-gilded borders.

projects.title: Aurelia Monogram Mantle Keepsake
projects.description: Deep archival arch featuring the client's wedding garland petals and hand-lettered gold calligraphy.
projects.longDescription: A towering 12-inch arched monument showcasing crimson red velvet roses, jasmine florets, and gold leaf confetti suspended in multi-level optical resin.

projects.title: Étoile Resin & Walnut Wall Clock
projects.description: 16-inch live-edge American walnut clock intertwined with shimmering pearl resin and dried wild foliage.
projects.longDescription: Functional sculpture uniting natural live-edge timber with bespoke rose-tinted pearl epoxy resin pours and silent German quartz movement.

projects.title: Lumière Botanical Night Lamp
projects.description: Solid optical resin cylinder with encased wild dandelions on an integrated warm LED solid beechwood base.
projects.longDescription: Using delicate preservation chambers, complete wild dandelion seed heads are captured intact without a single floating seed disturbed.

projects.title: Verdant Flora Vanity Tray
projects.description: Heavy brass-handled serving tray embedded with pressed hydrangeas, gold speckles, and mirror base.
projects.longDescription: Designed for bedside jewelry curation or luxury fragrance display. Sealed with scratch-resistant, heat-resistant top coat.
